description: This class, RpmModel, manages RPM sensor data with smoothing to prevent rapid UI updates for minor RPM fluctuations. It uses the singleton pattern, listens to sensor updates, and notifies registered listeners of RPM changes.

classes.name: RpmModel
classes.description: Singleton class providing RPM data with smoothing logic and observer pattern for updates.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RpmModel.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the RPM value and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current raw RPM value.

methods.name: getSmoothedValue
methods.description: Returns the RPM value after applying smoothing logic, considering update frequency and threshold.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for RPM change events.
